description: This source file implements the core functions related to SW session handling in a CWMP (TR-069) protocol stack, including methods for getting supported RPC methods, processing inform messages, transfer completion, and autonomous transfer completion. It includes detailed logic for constructing SOAP messages, handling parameters, and managing session states.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoGetRpcMethods(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_STRING_ARRAY ** ppMethodList,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported RPC method names supported by this CWMP session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoInform(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Builds and sends an Inform message to the ACS, including device information, parameters, and current time.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoTransferComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bIsDownload,char * pCommandKey,ANSC_HANDLE hFault,ANSC_HANDLE hStartTime,ANSC_HANDLE hCompleteTime,PULONG pulErrorCode,BOOL bAddEventCode)
methods.description: Notifies the server about the completion status of a file transfer initiated earlier.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoAutonomousTransferComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bIsDownload,ANSC_HANDLE hFault,ANSC_HANDLE hStartTime,ANSC_HANDLE hCompleteTime,char * AnnounceURL,char * TransferURL,char * FileType,unsigned int FileSize,char * TargetFileName,PULONG pulErrorCode,BOOL bAddEventCode)
methods.description: Informs the server of the completion of an autonomous file transfer initiated by an external event.

methods.name: CcspCwmpsoAutonomousTransferComplete
methods.description: Builds and sends an AutonomousTransferComplete message to the ACS, handling the transfer details and session state.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoKicked(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pCommand,char * pReferer,char * pArg,char * pNext,char ** ppNextUrl,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Handles the 'kicked' event, constructs and dispatches a corresponding SOAP message, and manages session states.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoRequestDownload(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pFileType,ANSC_HANDLE hFileTypeArgArray,ULONG ulArraySize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Initiates a file download request, constructs the SOAP message, and manages the asynchronous request process.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoDUStateChangeComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hDsccReq,PULONG pulErrorCode,BOOL bAddEventCode)
methods.description: Informs the server about the completion of a Download or Upload, with optional event logging and session management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoAutonomousDUStateChangeComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hAdsccReq,PULONG pulErrorCode,BOOL bAddEventCode)
methods.description: Notifies the server about the completion of an autonomous download/upload process, handling SOAP construction and request lifecycle.
